main.dev_device: Field devices with serial number, model, commissioning date, status, firmware version and last contact time; answers which devices exist and when each was last heard from.
main.dev_device_gateway: Which gateway each device connects through and its signal strength; answers how a device reaches the network.
main.dev_device_model: Device models with manufacturer, protocol and sample rate; answers what kind of hardware a device is.
main.dev_device_site_history: Where each device was installed and when it was moved; answers a device's location over time.
main.dev_device_v2: Migration copy of the device table; not for analysis.
main.dev_gateway: Network gateways per site with IP, uplink and status; answers which gateways serve a site.
main.dev_sensor: Sensors on each device with channel, measured quantity, unit and valid range; answers what each device measures.
main.dev_site: Physical sites with region, timezone and coordinates; answers where equipment is located.
main.ops_calibration: Calibration events per sensor with technician, offset, gain and next due date; answers when a sensor was last calibrated and when it is due.
main.ops_config_audit: Audit trail of configuration changes on devices with who, when, old and new value; answers what settings were changed.
main.ops_firmware_build: Firmware releases per device model with version, date and changelog; answers what the latest firmware is.
main.ops_firmware_rollout: Firmware update jobs per device with schedule, applied time, status and error; answers which updates succeeded or failed.
main.ops_maintenance_window: Planned maintenance periods per site with reason and alarm suppression; answers when equipment may be taken offline.
main.ops_work_order: Maintenance work orders per device with category, technician, dates and status; answers what repairs are open or done.
main.stg_device: Raw staged device records before transformation; not for analysis.
main.stg_reading: Raw staged sensor readings before transformation; not for analysis.
main.tel_alarm_ack: Acknowledgements of alarms with who and when; answers whether and when someone responded to an alarm.
main.tel_alarm_cleared: Alarm clearances with who, when and resolution; answers how and when alarms were resolved.
main.tel_alarm_raised: Alarms triggered on sensors with threshold, time, severity and value; answers what alarms went off.
main.tel_alarm_raised_old: Superseded copy of raised alarms; not for analysis.
main.tel_heartbeat: Periodic device check-ins with uptime, battery percentage and signal strength; answers device health and battery level.
main.tel_reading_1h: Hourly aggregated readings per sensor with average, min, max, p95 and count; answers hourly trends.
main.tel_reading_1h_bkp: Backup copy of hourly readings; not for analysis.
main.tel_reading_1m: Per-minute aggregated readings per sensor; answers minute-level trends.
main.tel_reading_raw: Every raw sensor sample with timestamp, value and quality; answers sub-minute detail.
main.tel_threshold: Alarm limits per sensor with severity, bounds and hysteresis; answers what values trigger a warning.
main.v_alarm_time_to_ack: Time from alarm raised to acknowledged, per alarm and severity; answers how long until someone responds.
main.v_calibration_overdue: Sensors whose next calibration date has passed; answers which instruments are overdue for a check.
main.v_device_current_site: Current site of each device and when it was installed there; answers where each device is now.
main.v_firmware_drift: Devices running an older firmware than the latest build; answers which kit is on outdated software.
main.v_hourly_site_average: Average reading per site per hour; answers site-level hourly trends.
main.v_low_battery: Devices whose battery has dropped below a threshold; answers which units are about to run flat.
main.v_open_alarms: Alarms raised but not yet cleared; answers which alarms are still active.
main.v_silent_devices: Active devices that have not reported recently; answers which devices have stopped communicating.
